literal_meaning: মাথা থাকা এবং ঘাড়ে দুটি থাকা (having a head and two necks)
figurative_meaning_en: To be audacious or extremely bold
similar_in_english: To have a lot of nerve
To have the gall to do something
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এমন সাহসী কাজ করেছে যেন তার মাথা থাকা, ঘাড়ে দুটো।
এই প্রস্তাবে সম্মতি দেওয়া মানে মাথা থাকা, ঘাড়ে দুটো।
example_sentences_in_english: He took such a risky action as if he had a head and two necks.
Agreeing to this proposal means having a head and two necks.
note: This idiom emphasizes extreme daring by exaggerating physical features, common in oral Bengali traditions.
